description: A sprite sheet of NINE separate small props arranged in a 3 by 3 grid, each small and centered in its own cell: round hay bale, wooden ox cart, wooden beehive box with bees, stone hand mill, small sheep pen with fence, low dry stone wall, hay feeding trough, stack of flour sacks, well with wooden crank winch, drawn in straight FRONT VIEW like the reference (facing the camera, slight top-down), thick dark outline, soft cel shading, every object fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with wide empty space around it, no ground, no shadow puddles, no text, no characters
style_usage: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view. Do not copy these objects or their colors.
